description:
Sell-side analyst consensus: price targets, the consensus recommendation, and the
recent rating trend (analyst counts over the last four months).

recommendation_mean runs 1.0 (strong buy) to 5.0 (strong sell). Price targets and
current_price are in the result's currency. ETFs, indices, and crypto have no
analyst coverage and return an error.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. 'AAPL'. Case-insensitive. Yahoo suffixes and prefixes are allowed (BRK-B, ^GSPC, RY.TO, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X); one symbol per value.

name: get_analyst_data

outputSchema.description: Sell-side analyst consensus and price targets as reported by Yahoo.

current_price.description: Latest traded price, in the result's currency.

number_of_analysts.description: Number of analysts contributing to the consensus estimates.

recommendation_mean.description: Mean analyst recommendation on a 1-5 scale: 1.0 = Strong Buy, 2.0 = Buy, 3.0 = Hold, 4.0 = Sell, 5.0 = Strong Sell.

recommendation_trend.description: Per-period recommendation counts, newest first (up to 4 months). Empty list if no analyst coverage data is available.

items.description: Analyst recommendation counts for one period bucket.

buy.description: Number of analysts with a Buy rating.

hold.description: Number of analysts with a Hold rating.

period.description: Period bucket relative to the current month: '0m' = current month, '-1m' = one month ago, '-2m' = two months ago, '-3m' = three months ago.

sell.description: Number of analysts with a Sell rating.

strong_buy.description: Number of analysts with a Strong Buy rating.

strong_sell.description: Number of analysts with a Strong Sell rating.

target_high_price.description: Highest analyst 12-month price target, in the result's currency.

target_low_price.description: Lowest analyst 12-month price target, in the result's currency.

target_mean_price.description: Mean analyst 12-month price target, in the result's currency.

target_median_price.description: Median analyst 12-month price target, in the result's currency.

title: Analyst Ratings & Price Targets
